display.purpose: Page and work-item titles, using Bahnschrift SemiCondensed where available.

label.purpose: IDs, branches, versions, and measurements only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Decisive actions use graphite at rest and signal lime on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{border:1px solid #171914;border-radius:6px;background:#171914;color:#f7f8f3;padding:10px 14px;font:700 13px Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease,transform .12s ease}.ds-btn-primary:hover{border-color:#b9f227;background:#b9f227;color:#182000}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #b9f227;outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Instrument-white search control with explicit focus calibration.
components.css: .ds-search{display:grid;gap:7px;color:#4f5349;font:700 11px Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif}.ds-search input{width:320px;border:1px solid #cdd1c5;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;color:#171914;padding:11px 12px;font:500 13px Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif}.ds-search input:focus{border-color:#171914;outline:2px solid #b9f227;outline-offset:0}

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Selected routes receive the full signal field.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;gap:4px;width:220px}.ds-nav button{border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:#4f5349;padding:10px 12px;text-align:left;font:650 13px Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#f7f8f3;color:#171914}.ds-nav .ds-active{border-color:#b9f227;background:#b9f227;color:#182000;font-weight:800}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #171914;outline-offset:1px}

components.name: Stage Badge
components.description: Compact categorical state; lime is reserved for the current stage.

components.name: Work Queue Row
components.description: Cardless operational row separating identity, title, branch, mode, and assignee.
components.css: .ds-row{width:620px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:4px 1fr 18px;align-items:center;gap:15px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #cdd1c5;background:transparent;padding:16px 8px 16px 0;text-align:left;color:#171914}.ds-row:hover{background:#fff}.ds-row>i{width:4px;height:38px;border-radius:2px;background:#647866}.ds-row span{display:grid;gap:6px}.ds-row code{color:#4f5349;font:700 11px Cascadia Code,monospace}.ds-row strong{font:740 15px Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif}.ds-row small{color:#6b7064;font:500 11px Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #b9f227;outline-offset:1px}

narrative.overview: ProjectBoard behaves like a physical operations desk for software work: one continuous surface, clearly labeled controls, visible routes, and unmistakable signal changes. The interface is dense enough for daily operation but keeps each screen centered on one decision. It rejects both generic card dashboards and theatrical neon hacker styling.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous work surfaces separated by alignment and hairlines, not card mosaics.
A cold daylight palette with one rare signal color.
Condensed, forceful headings paired with calm workhorse body copy.
Stage, branch, actor, and evidence are treated as operational notation.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Lime means selected, current, or ready for action. If an element carries no state, it does not receive the accent.

rules.name: The Notation Rule
rules.body: Monospace communicates machine-addressable information, never technical atmosphere.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Resting content has no shadow. Elevation indicates temporary focus or protected interaction.

dos: Do use one strong alignment grid per screen.
Do keep operational state visible without opening a drawer.
Do reserve lime for semantic signal and primary focus.
Do preserve full Chinese and English labels at narrow widths.
donts: Don't build dashboard mosaics from equal cards.
Don't use gradients, glass, neon glow, or decorative status dots.
Don't use icons without labels for primary navigation.
Don't collapse blocked, abandoned, or assignee state into color alone.
